load_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model and weights from a checkpoint file path using the fairchem registry
match_state_dicts: match a model state dict with a checkpoint state dict to handle DataParallel key prefix differences
get_deep_nested_value: retrieve a value from a nested dictionary using a dot-separated key path string
setup_logging: configure root logging with INFO to stdout and WARNING to stderr using the LOGLEVEL environment variable
get_subdirectories_sorted_by_time: get all subdirectories in a directory sorted by their last modification time as a list of tuples
